if: the expression 'plant and machinery' is used anywhere in Chapter V or Chapter VI of the CGST Act
then: it means apparatus, equipment and machinery FIXED TO EARTH by foundation or structural support, used for making outward supply, INCLUDING that foundation and those structural supports, but EXCLUDING (i) land, building or any other civil structures, (ii) telecommunication towers, and (iii) pipelines laid outside the factory premises
source_section: CGST Act s.17, Explanation to Chapters V and VI
note: Load-bearing for the construction blocks in s.17(5)(c) and (d): what falls outside this definition is blocked. Note the three express exclusions — a telecommunication tower and an outside-factory pipeline are NOT plant and machinery for this purpose, however they are capitalised in the books. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.
